purpose: Freeze hypotheses BEFORE the data that will test them exists. Every entry below was written on 2026-10-01; its confirmation window opens on 2026-10-02. A result found by slicing existing data is a DISCOVERY and appears here only as a hypothesis, never as evidence.
why_this_exists: The estate has repeatedly produced findings that looked strong and did not survive: an HT model AUC of 0.663 that was learning which leagues had missing data; a 'blend beats the market, +8.8% ROI over 226 bets' result that failed split-half, its bootstrap CI and a shuffled placebo; per-league threshold tuning where 10 of 10 genuinely-tested cells came back UNCHANGED. Each was discovered by searching. None was preregistered.
multiple_comparisons_policy: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across all hypotheses confirmed in the same review. A single cell clearing p<0.05 in isolation is not sufficient when many were examined.
amendment_policy: An entry may be READ freely and must not be EDITED once its confirmation window opens. Changing n_min, the metric, the test or the rejection criterion after seeing data voids that hypothesis; supersede it with a new versioned entry stating what changed and why, and keep the original.

hypotheses.title: BTTS edge persists in Argentina Primera Division
hypotheses.definition: Staked (SNIPER+MARKSMAN) BTTS selections in Argentina Primera Division.
hypotheses.discovery_evidence: n=64, +26.01u, ROI +40.6%, block-bootstrap CI [+0.066, +0.708] excluding zero, over 2026-08-22 to 2026-09-28.
hypotheses.primary_metric: ROI per bet, flat 1u, settled at entry price
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: CI lower bound <= 0 on >= 150 post-registration settled bets

hypotheses.title: BTTS edge exists OUTSIDE Argentina
hypotheses.definition: Staked BTTS selections in all leagues EXCEPT Argentina Primera Division.
hypotheses.discovery_evidence: n=36, +4.58u, ROI +12.7%, CI [-0.155, +0.402] INCLUDING zero. No edge demonstrated.
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: CI lower bound <= 0 on >= 150 post-registration settled bets
hypotheses.decision_value: THIS IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS. If H-BTTS-01 confirms and H-BTTS-02 fails, BTTS is an Argentina artifact and must never be extrapolated to other leagues. If both fail, the +30.60u was variance.

hypotheses.title: Market movement carries information per model track, not globally
hypotheses.definition: On main O/U staked bets with a captured price curve, ROI for mv_signal=CONFIRMED differs between new_format and standard tracks.
hypotheses.discovery_evidence: Full-curve read: new-format CONFIRMED +6.8%, standard CONFIRMED -12.7%. But at league x odds x timing x signal granularity only 19 cells reach n>=15, and exactly 1.0 of 19 would clear at a 5% threshold by chance — which is exactly how many did. The fine-grained cut is currently UNINFORMATIVE.
hypotheses.primary_metric: difference in ROI per bet between tracks within CONFIRMED
hypotheses.statistical_test: block bootstrap on the difference, 95% CI
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: CI on the between-track difference includes zero

hypotheses.title: The production CONFIRMED upgrade rule is not justified
hypotheses.definition: On main O/U staked bets, mv_signal=CONFIRMED does NOT outperform mv_signal=NEUTRAL.
hypotheses.discovery_evidence: Legacy drift_signal: Confirmed -10.8% ROI vs Neutral +8.0%, on a signal computed from odds_history_v9.json which holds only 260 keys against 408,405 rows of real curve.
hypotheses.statistical_test: block bootstrap on the difference, 95% CI
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: CI lower bound > 0, i.e. CONFIRMED genuinely outperforms, which would VINDICATE the current rule
hypotheses.note: Registered in the direction that would change production if CONFIRMED, i.e. this is a test of whether to REMOVE an existing rule.

hypotheses.title: HGB beats the corrected v9 stack on Over 2.5, prospectively
hypotheses.definition: HistGradientBoosting challenger versus the corrected FIT|CAL|META|HOLDOUT stack, on fixtures occurring after registration.
hypotheses.discovery_evidence: Historical holdout 2025-10-19 to 2026-09-28, n=11,836: delta log loss -0.00242, CI [-0.00445, -0.00038]. Note the CI upper bound does NOT clear the 0.001 material floor, so even the historical result is not decisive.
hypotheses.primary_metric: delta log loss versus the corrected stack on the same fixtures
hypotheses.statistical_test: block bootstrap on per-row log-loss delta, 95% CI must exclude zero AND the point estimate must clear -0.001
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: CI includes zero, or improvement smaller than the 0.001 material floor

hypotheses.title: V11 market+Wowza beats market alone in a defined segment
hypotheses.definition: Within segments having >= 3 bookmakers and entry 12-48h before kickoff, market+Wowza Brier is lower than market-alone Brier.
hypotheses.discovery_evidence: Globally market 0.2405 vs market+Wowza 0.2404, delta +0.00006, and Wowza helps in only 10 of 20 segments — a coin flip. No segment has yet been shown to differ.
hypotheses.primary_metric: paired Brier difference, market minus market+Wowza
hypotheses.statistical_test: block bootstrap, 95% CI excluding zero, plus a shuffled-probability placebo at p<0.05
hypotheses.rejection_criterion: CI includes zero or the placebo is indistinguishable
